# execution participant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:executionParticipant`](gmeow-executionParticipant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/executionParticipant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent that took part in an execution — the flat 80%-case shortcut. Non-functional. Promote to a [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) node when the role, period, confidence, or evidence of the participation must be recorded.
